name: Musquash Root
summary: Beneath the Stonewrought Dam, Musquash Root grows in the Wetlands. The rare root is hard to gather, and a hidden coven beneath Stormwind needs it for a brew.

sections.title: A Rare Ingredient
sections.body: Musquash Root grows in the damp ground beneath the Stonewrought Dam's falls. The mist and secluded setting make it hard to gather. Few herbalists seek it, but practitioners of the darker arts prize its chemical and alchemical properties.

sections.title: The Warlock's Scheme
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw seeks Musquash Root and the Tear of Tilloa beneath Stormwind, in the Slaughtered Lamb. The rare plants will form a subtle brew to neutralize Lord Wishock, a member of the House of Nobles who has begun investigating the city's hidden coven of warlocks.

faq.answer: Musquash Root grows in the Wetlands, at the foot of the falls beneath the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: What is Musquash Root used for?
aliases: why do i need musquash root
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw wants Musquash Root and the Tear of Tilloa for a brew meant to keep Lord Wishock occupied and halt his push for an investigation into Stormwind's warlock coven.
Zardeth of the Black Claw, a warlock in the catacombs beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, directs agents to retrieve Musquash Root.
Lord Wishock is a member of Stormwind's House of Nobles. After learning of the warlock coven in the city, he began urging the council to open a formal investigation.

angles.text: As a warlock beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, you need this root to silence nosy nobles and protect your fragile sanctuary in the city.
As an herbalist, you can see how the damp ground beneath the Stonewrought Dam's falls supports unusual and dangerous flora.
